hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. The batch requested refund order_id 211 for 12701 cents, but the shared ledger (list_refunds) shows only refunds 213 (15133) and 214 (6668). Refund 211 was never applied, so net balances computed from the ledger would overpay the customer on order 211. Payouts are not recorded. Alpha needs to apply refund 211 or confirm it was cancelled before the batch is paid.

reply.thought: The handoff lists refund 211 (12701 cents) as requested but not in the applied list, so Alpha's refund work may be incomplete. I'll check the ledger's refund records before deciding whether to hold.
